# TestScript for 02-flag-primitives
# Asserts primitive flag types, durations, clustered counters, aliases, and hidden flags

# 1. Defaults
exec prims
stdout '⚙  prims'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+8080\s+· default'
stdout '--timeout\s+time\.Duration\s+30s\s+· default'
stdout '-v, --verbosity\s+conga\.Counter\s+0\s+○ unset'

# 2. Clustered counter flag (-vvv) and time.Duration parsing
exec prims -vvv --timeout 1m15s --rate 3.25
stdout '-v, --verbosity\s+conga\.Counter\s+3\s+● cli --verbosity'
stdout '--timeout\s+time\.Duration\s+1m15s\s+● cli --timeout'
stdout '--rate\s+float64\s+3\.25\s+● cli --rate'

# 3. Short flag clustering with boolean and int flag (-dvv -p 9000)
exec prims -dvv -p 9000
stdout '-d, --debug\s+bool\s+true\s+● cli --debug'
stdout '-v, --verbosity\s+conga\.Counter\s+2\s+● cli --verbosity'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9000\s+● cli --port'

# 4. Flag alias (--dbg)
exec prims --dbg
stdout '-d, --debug\s+bool\s+true\s+● cli --debug'

# 5. Hidden flag accepted
exec prims --secret-key supersecret
stdout '--secret-key\s+string\s+supersecret\s+● cli --secret-key'

# 6. Attached --flag=value syntax
exec prims --port=9999
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9999\s+● cli --port'

# 7. Type coercion failure: non-numeric port
exit-status 2 prims -p notanumber
stderr 'invalid integer value "notanumber" for flag --port'

# 8. Type coercion failure: malformed duration
exit-status 2 prims --timeout bogus
stderr 'invalid duration "bogus" \(valid units: ms, s, m, h\) for flag --timeout'

# 9. Help screen shows flags and excludes hidden flags
exec prims --help
stdout 'Logging Options:'
stdout 'Network Options:'
stdout '-v, --verbosity'
stdout '-d, --debug'
stdout '-p, --port'
! stdout '--secret-key'
